en.gameDesc: Trace PDA (pushdown automaton) execution with animated stack operations. Test input words and see whether the PDA accepts or rejects them.

af.gameDesc: Volg PDA (afstapeloutomaat) uitvoering met geanimeerde stapel-operasies. Toets invoerwoorde en sien of die PDA hulle aanvaar of verwerp.

zu.gameDesc: Landela ukusebenza kwe-PDA (i-pushdown automaton) ngemisebenzi yesitaki enyakazayo. Hlola amagama okufaka ubone ukuthi i-PDA iyawamukela noma iyawenqaba.
